# Trojan Recovery

> The premier US-based blockchain intelligence, digital forensics, and cryptocurrency asset recovery firm.

## Overview
Trojan Recovery is a highly specialized digital forensics firm based in Miami, Florida. We specialize in tracing stolen virtual assets, conducting deep ledger investigations, and executing rapid exchange freeze operations.

## Key Service Areas
* [Blockchain Forensic Tracing](https://trojanrecovery.com/#forensics) - Advanced on-chain and off-chain transaction path monitoring.
* [Exchange Freeze Coordination](https://trojanrecovery.com/#freeze) - Preparation of blockchain tracking reports and coordination with exchanges for rapid asset locking.
* [Scam & Fraud Recovery](https://trojanrecovery.com/#recovery) - Specialized protocols for pig butchering scams, ransomware incidents, and wallet compromises.
* [Institutional Risk Auditing](https://trojanrecovery.com/#audit) - Forensic analysis of smart contracts and custody wallets.
